text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer, more controlled sentences with subordinating structures","quality":"sentence complexity","description":"Uses more varied and elaborated sentence structures to connect ideas and build reasoning."},{"evidence":"“Firstly... secondly... lastly...” and repeated signposting","quality":"organization","description":"Presents ideas in a clearer, more explicitly structured sequence with stronger paragraph-to-paragraph cohesion."},{"evidence":"“This also reflects their environment in school therefore, it can be said...”","quality":"development of ideas","description":"Expands points with more explanation and logical extension rather than simple personal illustration."},{"evidence":"“critical analyzing... open-mindedly and collaboratively”","quality":"academic vocabulary","description":"Uses more school-like, abstract vocabulary to express ideas in a more formal register."},{"evidence":"“detirriation,” “councilors,” “de-stress,” “life itself”","quality":"lexical control","description":"Shows generally stronger command of word choice and spelling even though there are still some errors."},{"evidence":"“if they dont take breaks their grades are probably going to drop”","quality":"argumentative reasoning","description":"Makes fuller causal claims and connects evidence to consequences more convincingly."}]}
